Prevention: Deep ploughing with a chisel plough.
Locate the termite mounds/termitarium and destroy colonies.
Reduction of size of field bund.
Maintain the width of field bund at 30 cm.
Monitoring: Monitor for termite mounds during dry weather periods.

Symptoms include semi-circular feeding marks on the margin of the leaves, damage to canopies and drying of central shoots. 15% of dried central shoot is considered a trigger to action the direct control recommendations.
Monitor for the presence of loose soil, deposits of pressed mud and movement of worker temites.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Collection and destruction of the termite affected setts from the field.
Pour the juice of immature papaya fruit on termite mounds (100 ml of papaya juice dissolved in 5 litres of water per mound).
Kheemp at a rate of 5 litres per acre in irrigation channels.
Pseudomonas fluorescens at a rate of 10 g per litre or spraying of
Bacillus thuringiensis 5 ml per litre of water.
Metarrhizium anisopliae 2 grams per litre on termite mounds.
Bacillus thuringiensis 5 ml per litre of water on the termite mounds and also on the infected root portions.
Direct Control (Chemical): Avoid spraying of resurgence causing insecticide.
Always wear protective clothing when handling chemicals.
WS, Chemida70WS) 1 ml per litre of water.
RegentSC, Devigent plus, Fipro) at a rate of 350 ml per acre.
Gold) at a rate of 100 ml/acre.
Actara, Click, Evident) at a rate of 50 g per acre.
